value.rationale: Q4 is the smallest nontrivial square-dimensional fully frustrated cell attaining the orthogonal spectral bound, singled out in the classical spin-glass literature. The entire 9-level energy density—not known 16-fold ground count alone—determines the exact finite-T thermodynamic observables and reveals a 120-fold jump in multiplicity at the first excitation. It is a motivated natural complete finite invariant/benchmark, not an arbitrary induced subgraph or unsubstantiated thermodynamic-limit claim.
